## [GOTCHA:9] Any script or tool that installs a local-path Pi extension (e.g., install.sh for pi-extension) mu...

Pi `pi install /local/path` stores the path as a reference in `~/.pi/agent/settings.json` — it NEVER copies the files. If the source directory is deleted (e.g., extracted to mktemp and cleaned up), the extension breaks on next Pi session. Bootstrap scripts must copy dist/ to a persistent location (e.g., ~/.octocode/extensions/pi-extension/) BEFORE calling pi install. Source: packages.md "Local paths point to files or directories on disk and are added to settings without copying."

Refs: file:<external-path-redacted>

## [DECISION:8] Prompt-optimizer advanced technique playbook

For agent prompts, start with a direct contract and a success eval. Add only the technique tied to the observed failure: examples for edge format, schemas for machine output, retrieval for external facts, tools for actions, typed chaining for stages, bounded candidates for ambiguous decisions, and caching for stable prefixes.

Refs: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-engineering, https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/overview
